bullets: Building backend systems and developer tooling for the platform.
WIP...
Designed and maintained a high-throughput ffmpeg wrapper in Golang for the VaaS (Video as a Service) platform, enabling multi-bitrate transcoding and adaptive HLS/DASH streaming.
Built fault-tolerant video encoding pipelines using Golang and message queues (RabbitMQ/Kafka), supporting thousands of concurrent transcoding jobs with automatic retries and dead-letter handling.
Converted a PHP backend monolith to a distributed microservice architecture using Golang, improving horizontal scalability and reducing inter-service coupling.
Designed and maintained an observability stack with Prometheus and Grafana to track encoding pipeline SLIs, define SLOs, and alert on throughput and latency degradations.
Participated in on-call rotations and led incident response for the VaaS platform, diagnosing pipeline failures and restoring service availability.
Implemented structured logging and distributed tracing across video processing services to detect bottlenecks and reduce mean time to recovery (MTTR).
Developed platform panels to identify vulnerabilities and display detailed information about hosts and their services. Utilized Golang for performance and ReactJS for reusability.
Developed a crawler-like agent & C2 using Golang and the Docker containerization SDK to systematically search through hosts, identify services, and pinpoint vulnerabilities along with their CVEs.
Enhanced the agent's capabilities by integrating a custom Nmap library using Golang for performant host scanning, service identification, and detection of open ports.
Automated and containerized projects to streamline deployment and ease integration into DevOps workflows.
Designed and implemented a role-based access control system with full CRUD for a server-side application to ensure secure user permissions and data access.
Implemented a RESTful API for a web application; designed endpoints and collaborated with the front-end team for seamless integration.
Developed a custom API for a machine vision application using the Pypylon library, enabling real-time monitoring and control of Basler camera temperature.
Developed and maintained technical documentation for Linux and web projects.
Developed Python automation scripts for embedded-systems projects in the field of car plate detection.
Built a Python module for interacting with a PHP-based web interface to control Docker containers.
Implemented Network File System (NFS) on a large-scale enterprise network with multiple locations to improve file access times and ensure data integrity.
Implemented security measures such as firewall rules and permissions management to protect sensitive data on the NFS network.
Wrote Bash scripts to automate Linux OS image deployment across multiple servers simultaneously.
Worked with Linux distros including Ubuntu, CentOS, LFS, and Debian.

namira-core.description: A high-performance, self-hosted quality assurance toolkit for VPN proxy configurations. Validates, benchmarks, and ranks VMess, VLESS, Trojan, and Shadowsocks connections with real TCP handshakes and latency measurements.

xraygen.description: Generates XRay JSON configs and automates XRay deployment on the server side.

cfscanner.description: Cloud Flare Scanner. I wrote the Golang section of this project.

gfwknock.description: Bypass GFW detection with packet fragmentation method PoC, written in Golang.

rabbitmq-perobject-dashboard.description: RabbitMQ Per Object Dashboard, a per-queue / per-exchange RabbitMQ metrics for debugging backlogs, stuck consumers, and routing issues. Powered by the rabbitmq_prometheus plugin's /metrics/per-object endpoint.

djangomq.description: RESTful API that sends & receives messages using the RabbitMQ / AMQP protocol.

sonarping.description: A multi-ping tool for sending ICMP requests, written in Python.
